fr_html: LORD PHILLIMORE pense qu'il ne s'agit que de questions de formule, et le PRESIDENT déclare que le Comité de rédaction tiendra compte de cet amendement.
en_html: LORD PHILLIMORE thought that this amendment was only a question of wording. The PRESIDENT stated that the drafting Committee would consider the amendment.
